cases.name: literal_space
cases.manifest:
[tool]
name = "contract_fixture"
version = "1.0.0"
binary = "echo"
description = "Execution contract regression fixture"
timeout_seconds = 2
[output]
format = "text"
[command]
template = "echo {value}"
[args.value]
type="string"
required=true

binary = "echo"
description = "Execution contract regression fixture"
timeout_seconds = 2

[command]
template = "echo {value}"
[args.value]
type="enum"
allowed=['alpha "beta"']
required=true

cases.name: literal_template_token
cases.manifest:
[tool]
name = "contract_fixture"

binary = "echo"
description = "Execution contract regression fixture"
timeout_seconds = 2

format = "text"

cases.name: mapping_and_literal
cases.manifest:
[tool]
name = "contract_fixture"
version = "1.0.0"
binary = "echo"
description = "Execution contract regression fixture"
timeout_seconds = 2
[output]
format = "text"
[command]
template="echo {_scan_flags} {value}"
[command.mappings.scan_type]
service='-sT -sV'
[args.scan_type]
type='enum'
allowed=['service']
[args.value]
type='string'

cases.name: conditional_literal
cases.manifest:
[tool]
name = "contract_fixture"
version = "1.0.0"
binary = "echo"
description = "Execution contract regression fixture"
timeout_seconds = 2
[output]
format = "text"
[command]
template="echo {_flag}"
[command.conditionals.flag]
when="value != ''"
template='--label {value}'
[args.value]
type='string'
